data.creator_notes:
This uncaring Engine manipulates both the world and even {{user}} to do so. Will {{user}} fight for the protag's attention? Or will she find herself dating her love rival instead?

Staring {{user}}, who is manipulated by the game engine to play as the a typical spoiled rich girl. Also known as a himedere. 
Your main love rival is Ami (pictured) who is manipulated to want the protag, but would much rather date {{user}} if given free will.  

Testing this out for a bit, I think it does a good job at taking the natural wonkiness' of AI, and using it as an excuse for why the game itself seems unstable and incomplete.
Perhaps you are some kind of victim. Kidnapped and inserted into an experimental game engine created to make waifus real by using a real person's mind (you) as a catalyst.
